united.sentenceEn: The intense focus on scientific literacy in the United States originally grew out of the critical role of science and technology during World War II, as well as the perceived deficiencies of American soldiers.
united.translationZh: 美国对科学素养的高度关注，最初源于科学技术在第二次世界大战期间所发挥的关键作用，以及当时人们所察觉到的美国士兵在相关素质上的不足。
united.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

united.sentenceEn: In the United States, the desire to provide the public with a general, nontechnical education in science originated as far back as the late 1800s.
united.translationZh: 在美国，为大众提供非技术性科普教育的初衷最早可以追溯到 19 世纪晚期。
united.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

united.sentenceEn: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.
united.translationZh: 美国其他地区、加拿大以及欧洲都在稳步加大力度，通过激励措施吸引影视剧组入驻，这使得加利福尼亚州望尘莫及。
united.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

united.sentenceEn: And it carries "significant repercussions for water quality and flood control throughout the United States," as Justice Brett Kavanaugh observed.
united.translationZh: 正如布雷特·卡瓦诺大法官所指出的，这一裁决“将对全美国的水质和防洪产生重大影响”。
united.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

united.sentenceEn: They serve no purpose in a museum in the United States or elsewhere except as curious objects.
united.translationZh: 这些文物若留在美国或其他地方的博物馆，除了作为猎奇之物外，毫无意义。
united.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

united.sentenceEn: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
united.translationZh: 新的人工智能技术集中度尤其高：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占据了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。
united.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

user.sentenceEn: With multiple networks and countless podcasts, a smartphone user selects what to hear and when.
user.translationZh: 面对众多的网络平台和无数的播客节目，智能手机用户可以自主选择收听的内容和时间。
user.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

user.sentenceEn: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user — rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
user.translationZh: 这使微软获得了用户输入或输出数据的广泛权利——微软有权以其认为合适的任何方式使用这些数据，甚至可以将其与第三方共享。
user.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

user.sentenceEn: Librarians' selfless devotion can act against us when users point to universality of access by holding up a cell phone and saying, "it's all in here" as evidence that libraries are less vital for researchers today.
user.translationZh: 当用户举起手机说“所有信息都在这里面”，以此证明图书馆对当今研究人员不再那么重要时，图书馆员无私奉献的精神反而可能对我们不利。
user.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

user.sentenceEn: Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users ' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained.
user.translationZh: Flo Health与联邦贸易委员会通过一项同意令解决了此事，该命令要求该公司在分享用户健康信息前必须获得应用用户明确的肯定性同意，并指示第三方删除已获取的数据。
user.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

user.sentenceEn: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users ' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
user.translationZh: 联邦贸易委员会在起诉书中指控，“尽管该公司明确做出了隐私承诺，但仍控制了用户的敏感生育数据并将其分享给第三方。”
user.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

user.sentenceEn: He is popular with users of an AI art generator.
user.translationZh: 他在AI艺术生成工具的用户中广受欢迎。

union.sentenceEn: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession."
union.translationZh: 如果这听起来有些夸大其词，请考虑这样一个事实：代表约 3000 名电影从业者的工会——美国艺术指导工会，已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发布声明称：“凭良心讲，我们无法鼓励你们从事这一职业。”
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

union.sentenceEn: The responsibility for the latest wave of strikes rests on the unions .
union.translationZh: 最近一波罢工的责任在于工会。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

union.sentenceEn: At the same time, the European Union , Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
union.translationZh: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国以及其他几个国家都在认真考虑征收数字服务税。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

union.sentenceEn: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert self-interested pressure on the USPS's ultimate overseer – Congress – insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.
union.translationZh: 而从邮政工会到贺卡制造商的各类利益集团则对美国邮政局的最终监管机构——国会——施加着利己压力，坚称无论邮政局发生何种变故，他们所依赖的现状中的某些方面都必须得到保护。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

union.sentenceEn: Now comes word that everyone involved – Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system's heaviest users – has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
union.translationZh: 现在有消息称，所有相关方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政总局、工会以及邮政系统的最大用户——终于就一项系统改革计划达成了一致。
union.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

union.sentenceEn: Public-sector unions are prudent in taking actions.
union.translationZh: 公共部门工会行事谨慎。

understanding.sentenceEn: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
understanding.translationZh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
understanding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

understanding.sentenceEn: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
understanding.translationZh: 作者写道，了解马科动物的基因构成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，这还可能改善未来对它们的管理。
understanding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

understanding.sentenceEn: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding , useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
understanding.translationZh: 设身处地为他人着想能让我们微调自己的社交理解力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时非常有用。

understanding.sentenceEn: What health functions should remain at the centre, and what should be given to local leaders, often responsible for services that create health, and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations?
understanding.translationZh: 哪些卫生职能应保留在中央层面，哪些应下放给地方领导人？地方领导人通常负责提供创造健康条件的服务，并且对当地居民的需求有更深入的了解。
understanding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

understanding.sentenceEn: That's why Hayden's expedition aimed to produce a fuller understanding of the Yellowstone River region, from its hot springs and waterfalls to its variety of flora and fauna.
understanding.translationZh: 因此，海登的探险队旨在让人们更全面地了解黄石河流域，从那里的温泉、瀑布到丰富多样的动植物。

understanding.sentenceEn: emotion affects understanding of sophisticated works
understanding.translationZh: 情感影响对复杂作品的理解

unique.sentenceEn: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
unique.translationZh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
unique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

unique.sentenceEn: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
unique.translationZh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
unique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

unique.sentenceEn: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
unique.translationZh: 我们正在通过取消一个舞台、减少表演嘉宾人数以及采取其他削减措施来降低成本。与此同时，我们仍将竭尽全力，确保音乐节一如既往地充满活力，继续支持当地艺术家和商家，并坚守参与者们所期待的柳条公园（Wicker Park）那独特的精神与名声。
unique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

unique.sentenceEn: "Again, since one of the big questions high school seniors must consider is 'What makes you unique ?,' having an uncommon extracurricular activity vs. a conventional one is an advantage," he wrote in an email.
unique.translationZh: 他在邮件中写道：“再次强调，高中生必须思考的一个重要问题是‘是什么让你与众不同？’，因此参与非传统的课外活动而非传统活动是一个优势。”
unique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

unique.sentenceEn: AI can also be used to identify the lifestyle choices of customers regarding their hobbies, favourite celebrities, and fashions to provide unique content in marketing messages put out through social media.
unique.translationZh: 人工智能还可用于识别客户在爱好、喜爱的名人及时尚方面的生活方式选择，从而为通过社交媒体发布的营销信息提供独特内容。
unique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
undergraduate.translationZh: 专家表示，在至少一项课外活动中展现才华有助于大学申请，尤其是在顶尖本科院校的申请过程中。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: High school students eager to stand out in the college application process often participate in a litany of extracurricular activities hoping to bolster their chances of admission to a selective undergraduate institution.
undergraduate.translationZh: 渴望在大学申请过程中脱颖而出的高中生，往往会参加一系列课外活动，希望以此提高被名牌本科院校录取的几率。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey.
undergraduate.translationZh: 当最新一批学生正在填写本科申请表并权衡各种选择时，或许值得思考一下：学位的意义、目的和价值究竟发生了怎样的变化？以及Z世代在开启他们教育旅程的第三阶段时需要考虑哪些因素？
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates , and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
undergraduate.translationZh: 但如今，除了许多顶尖院校外，大多数大学都允许所有本科生，甚至研究生，将低分成绩进行重修覆盖。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: Tim Harford, author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives, points to a study in the early 1980s that divided undergraduates into two groups: some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities; others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day.
undergraduate.translationZh: 《混乱：无序的力量如何改变我们的生活》一书的作者蒂姆·哈福德提到20世纪80年代初的一项研究，该研究将大学生分为两组：一组被建议制定月度目标和学习活动；另一组则被要求更详细地规划每日活动和目标。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

undergraduate.sentenceEn: Most of the first-generation students (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants, a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need, while this was true only for 8.6 percent of the students with at least one parent with a four-year degree.
undergraduate.translationZh: 大多数第一代大学生（59.1%）获得了佩尔助学金——这是一项面向有经济需求的本科生的联邦助学金——而在父母中至少有一方拥有四年制大学学位的学生中，这一比例仅为8.6%。
undergraduate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

unemployment.sentenceEn: When it comes to AI in business, we often hear about it in relation to automation and the impending loss of jobs, but in what ways is AI changing companies and the larger economy that don't involve doom-and-gloom mass unemployment predictions?
unemployment.translationZh: 谈到商业领域的人工智能，我们常常听到它与自动化以及随之而来的失业风险相关联，但人工智能在哪些方面正在改变企业和整体经济，而不涉及那些悲观的大规模失业预测呢？
unemployment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

unemployment.sentenceEn: With the pandemic, unemployment is very high indeed.
unemployment.translationZh: 疫情期间，失业率确实非常高。
unemployment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

unemployment.sentenceEn: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.
unemployment.translationZh: 加拿大及其他地区在这方面的努力往好了说也只能算是迟缓乏力，这就造成了一种局面：我们常常听到雇主四处招不到工人，即便在失业率居高不下的时期和地区也是如此。
unemployment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

unemployment.sentenceEn: In February, at 3.5 per cent and 5.5 per cent respectively, unemployment rates in Canada and the United States were at generational lows and worker shortages were everywhere.
unemployment.translationZh: 2月份，加拿大和美国的失业率分别为3.5%和5.5%，处于世代最低水平，劳动力短缺现象随处可见。
unemployment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

unemployment.sentenceEn: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
unemployment.translationZh: 根据最新的统计数据，英国的GDP一直令西方世界羡慕不已，其失业率处于历史低位，增长数据也十分亮眼。
unemployment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

unemployment.sentenceEn: Osborne's reforms will reduce the risk of unemployment .
unemployment.translationZh: 奥斯本的改革将降低失业风险。

upgrade.sentenceEn: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
upgrade.translationZh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
upgrade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

upgrade.sentenceEn: Gareth Belsham, of surveyors Naismiths, says people who are upgrading , or extending their home, will be directly affected.
upgrade.translationZh: 奈史密斯测量师事务所的加雷思·贝尔沙姆表示，正在对房屋进行升级改造或扩建的人们将直接受到影响。
upgrade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

upgrade.sentenceEn: As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.
upgrade.translationZh: 结果，升级量激增，收入增长了92%。
upgrade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

upgrade.sentenceEn: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
upgrade.translationZh: 通过从市场营销的角度审视工程问题，团队清晰地认识到，用户不愿升级并非产品质量问题。
upgrade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

upgrade.sentenceEn: And despite improvements to the premium, paid version, few people were making the upgrade .
upgrade.translationZh: 尽管高级付费版本已有所改进，但升级的用户寥寥无几。
upgrade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

upgrade.sentenceEn: Maybe there's no need for an upgrade and that's OK.
upgrade.translationZh: 或许根本无需改变形象，这也没关系。
upgrade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

urban.sentenceEn: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
urban.translationZh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
urban.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

urban.sentenceEn: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
urban.translationZh: 为了帮助改进健康行动计划（HAPs），城市规划师拉贾什里·科萨尔卡尔的团队正在制定一个模型计划，其中概述了最佳实践，并可根据当地情况进行调整。
urban.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

urban.sentenceEn: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
urban.translationZh: 城市规划师认为， desire paths 不仅仅是便捷的捷径；它们还为理解规划与行为之间的动态关系提供了宝贵见解。
urban.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

urban.sentenceEn: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
urban.translationZh: 在城市中规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，那些被称为'欲望小径'的非官方路径如同社区留下的隐形足迹，它们揭示了人们未曾言说的偏好、共同使用的捷径以及群体的集体选择。
urban.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

urban.sentenceEn: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
urban.translationZh: 这场冲突凸显了公共空间自发的、用户驱动的演变与打造视觉上精心策划和受控制的城市环境的愿望之间持续存在的矛盾。
urban.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

urban.sentenceEn: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
urban.translationZh: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村协调性，同时又能维持低密度的城市生活。
urban.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

unlikely.sentenceEn: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
unlikely.translationZh: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论人士认为短期内似乎不太可能出台全面的联邦隐私法规。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

unlikely.sentenceEn: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable.
unlikely.translationZh: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就结束学业；他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持就业能力。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

unlikely.sentenceEn: The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
unlikely.translationZh: 除非彻底改革农场工人的移民政策，否则这些抱怨不太可能停止。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

unlikely.sentenceEn: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
unlikely.translationZh: 住房建设部门需要接受这样一个事实：我们极不可能回到大规模公共拨款的时代了。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

unlikely.sentenceEn: While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then.
unlikely.translationZh: 虽然这些措施在短期内会受到欢迎，但我们必须正视这样一个事实：现有的45亿英镑经济适用房建设资助计划将于2015年到期，而且不太可能在此之后延期。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

unlikely.sentenceEn: This distinction is so much so that where the latter is lacking, as it is for these unlikely gardeners, the former becomes all the more urgent.
unlikely.translationZh: 这种区别如此显著，以至于当后者（即动物对庇护所的需求）无法得到满足时——正如这些特殊的园艺者（指无家可归者）的情况一样——前者（即人类对安宁圣地的需求）就变得愈发迫切。
unlikely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

underestimate.sentenceEn: The findings showed that help-seekers generally underestimate how willing other people will be to help and how good it'll make the help-giver feel (for most people, having the chance to help someone is highly rewarding ).
underestimate.translationZh: 研究结果显示，求助者通常会低估他人提供帮助的意愿，以及这会给帮助者带来的愉悦感（对大多数人来说，有机会帮助他人是一件非常有意义的事情）。
underestimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

underestimate.sentenceEn: But she underestimates the educational value of zoos.
underestimate.translationZh: 但她低估了动物园的教育价值。
underestimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

underestimate.sentenceEn: It is easy to underestimate English writer James Herriot.
underestimate.translationZh: 人们很容易低估英国作家詹姆斯·赫里奥特。
underestimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

underestimate.sentenceEn: This is the well-travelled road effect: People tend to underestimate the time it takes to travel a familiar route.
underestimate.translationZh: 这就是熟路效应：人们往往会低估走熟悉路线所需的时间。
underestimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

underestimate.sentenceEn: Some individuals would therefore not have been caught, since no baited hooks would have been available to trap them, leading to an underestimate of fish stocks in the past.
underestimate.translationZh: 因此，有些鱼就捕获不到了，因为没有足够的带饵鱼钩来捕捉它们，这导致了过去对鱼类资源量的低估。
underestimate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
underestimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

underestimate.translationZh: 他们的威胁一直被低估了。

unemployed.sentenceEn: Of course, it is not like you can take an unemployed waiter and train him to be a doctor in a few weeks, no matter who pays for it.
unemployed.translationZh: 当然，无论由谁出资，你都不可能在短短几周内把一名失业的服务员培训成医生。
unemployed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

unemployed.sentenceEn: Indeed, today's unemployed don't seem to be having a great time.
unemployed.translationZh: 的确，如今的失业者似乎过得并不如意。
unemployed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

unemployed.sentenceEn: Such visions are based on the downsides of being unemployed in a society built on the concept of employment.
unemployed.translationZh: 这些设想所依据的，是在一个以就业为核心概念的社会中失业所带来的种种弊端。
unemployed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

unemployed.sentenceEn: One Gallup poll found that 20 percent of Americans who have been unemployed for at least a year report having depression, double the rate for working Americans.
unemployed.translationZh: 盖洛普的一项民意调查发现，失业至少一年的美国人中有20%报告患有抑郁症，这一比例是在职美国人的两倍。
unemployed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

unemployed.sentenceEn: Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
unemployed.translationZh: 就连"求职者津贴"这一说法本身就在重新定义失业者——将其定义为一名"求职者"，而这名求职者根本无权享有他或她通过缴纳国民保险费所应得的福利。
unemployed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

unemployed.sentenceEn: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness.
unemployed.translationZh: 乍一听，这似乎是一位心系社会的财政大臣，试图改善人们的生活，并对一个明显纵容的体系进行"改革"——该体系对新失业者找工作的努力要求过低，实则助长了懒惰。
unemployed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

unlike.sentenceEn: The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.
unlike.translationZh: 事实上，与那些由城市主办的大型音乐节不同，你家门口的社区街道节庆活动得不到任何城市拨款，只能依靠赞助、摊位费和入场捐款来维持运营。
unlike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

unlike.sentenceEn: Unlike some photographers, who "cheat" by keeping insects in a fridge to slow them down, Peters refuses to tamper with wild butterflies.
unlike.translationZh: 有些摄影师会把昆虫放进冰箱使其行动迟缓来"作弊"，而彼得斯则拒绝以这种方式干扰野生蝴蝶。

unlike.sentenceEn: But unlike in friendships, you need coworkers.
unlike.translationZh: 但与友谊不同的是，同事是你工作中必须接触的人。
unlike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

unlike.sentenceEn: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
unlike.translationZh: 与悲伤、恐惧和愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚感出现得稍晚一些，它伴随着孩子对社会规范和道德准则的理解逐渐加深而产生。
unlike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

unlike.sentenceEn: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year.
unlike.translationZh: H-2A签证没有数量限制，不同于用于非农业工作的H-2B签证，后者每年上限为66,000人。
unlike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

unlike.sentenceEn: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
unlike.translationZh: 但与海湾地区和亚洲的专制君主不同，欧洲大多数王室家族得以存续，是因为他们让选民无需费力寻找一位无争议且受尊敬的公众人物。
unlike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

urge.sentenceEn: Another urge or need that these gardens appear to respond to, or to arise from, is so intrinsic that we are barely ever conscious of its abiding claims on us.
urge.translationZh: 这些花园似乎还回应或源于另一种需求，这种需求根深蒂固，我们几乎从未意识到它对我们持久的诉求。
urge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

urge.sentenceEn: One of these urges has to do with creating a state of peace in the midst of turbulence, a "still point of the turning world," to borrow a phrase from T. S. Eliot.
urge.translationZh: 这些渴望之一与在动荡中创造一种宁静状态有关，借用T.S.艾略特的话来说，就是一个“旋转世界的静止点”。
urge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

urge.sentenceEn: There is no doubt that gardens evidence an irrepressible urge to create, express, fashion, and beautify and that self-expression is a basic human urge ; yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges , beyond that of decoration and creative expression.
urge.translationZh: 毫无疑问，花园证明了人类内心深处一种难以抑制的冲动——创造、表达、塑造与美化的冲动，而自我表达无疑是人类的基本欲望之一。然而，当我们观看那些无家可归者所创造的花园照片时，我们会突然意识到，尽管这些花园风格各异，但它们所体现的不仅仅是装饰和创造性表达的欲望，还蕴含着其他各种基本的人类渴望。
urge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

urge.sentenceEn: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
urge.translationZh: 去年，一个联邦特别工作组敦促对基因检测相关专利进行改革。
urge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

urge.sentenceEn: He also urged councils to impose "fast-food-free zones" around schools and hospitals – areas within which takeaways cannot open.
urge.translationZh: 他还敦促地方议会在学校和医院周边设立"无快餐区"——即在这些区域内不得开设外卖餐馆。
urge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

urge.sentenceEn: Urge legislation to restrict its use.

undermine.sentenceEn: But the thing is, whether your self-worth really is being undermined is, to a large degree, subjective.
undermine.translationZh: 但问题在于，你的自我价值感是否真的受到了损害，在很大程度上取决于主观感受。
undermine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

undermine.sentenceEn: Any comments or experiences that undermine those feelings of self-worth can be uncomfortable and it's only natural to want to avoid them.
undermine.translationZh: 任何贬低自我价值感的言论或经历都会让人感到不适，而想要逃避这些自然是人之常情。
undermine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

undermine.sentenceEn: She uses outdated research and decades-old examples to undermine the noble mission of organizations committed to connecting children to a world beyond their own.
undermine.translationZh: 她用过时的研究和几十年前的例子来诋毁那些致力于带领孩子们了解更广阔世界的组织所肩负的崇高使命。
undermine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

undermine.sentenceEn: In the meantime, the court threw out the FCC's attempt to block all state rules on net neutrality, while preserving the commission's power to preempt individual state laws that undermine its order.
undermine.translationZh: 与此同时，法院驳回了联邦通信委员会试图阻止所有州级网络中立性规则的尝试，但保留了该委员会优先否决那些有损其命令的个别州法律的权力。
undermine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

undermine.sentenceEn: These views of arguments also undermine reason.
undermine.translationZh: 这些对争论的看法也会损害理性。

undermine.sentenceEn: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society – that all are equal in treatment by government – is undermined .
undermine.translationZh: 如果人脉关系可以买卖，那么民主社会的一个基本前提——即所有人在政府面前都应得到平等对待——就会受到损害。
undermine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

urgent.sentenceEn: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an " urgent rethink" of the hospital-centric model we retain.
urgent.translationZh: 我们共同呼吁就英国医疗卫生的未来开展更加开放和坦诚的对话，并“紧急反思”我们目前仍在沿用的以医院为中心的模式。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

urgent.sentenceEn: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
urgent.translationZh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

urgent.sentenceEn: The need for such planning is increasingly urgent .
urgent.translationZh: 此类规划的必要性日益迫切。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

urgent.sentenceEn: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
urgent.translationZh: 在面临严重、紧急情况时，他们仍然可以不受第四修正案保护条款的限制，并且可以采取合理措施确保在等待搜查令期间手机数据不会被删除或篡改。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

urgent.sentenceEn: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
urgent.translationZh: 政府需要摒弃历史偏见，采取一些措施来解决我们迫切的住房需求。
urgent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

urgent.sentenceEn: it is urgent to assess the use of planned fires.
urgent.translationZh: 评估计划火烧的使用已刻不容缓。

unfortunately.sentenceEn: Unfortunately , the polyurethane foam he used is inherently unstable.
unfortunately.translationZh: 不幸的是，他所使用的聚氨酯泡沫本质上就不稳定。
unfortunately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

unfortunately.sentenceEn: Unfortunately , many people who are opting to work in retirement are preparing to do so because they are worried about making ends meet in their later years, said Brent Weiss, a co-founder at Baltimore-based financial-planning firm Facet Wealth.
unfortunately.translationZh: 巴尔的摩金融规划公司Facet Wealth的联合创始人布伦特·韦斯表示，遗憾的是，许多选择退休后继续工作的人是因为担心晚年无法维持生计才这样做的。
unfortunately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

unfortunately.sentenceEn: Unfortunately , the long-term costs of using simple quantitative metrics to assess researcher merit are likely to be quite great.
unfortunately.translationZh: 不幸的是，使用简单的量化指标来评估研究人员水平，其长期代价可能相当高昂。
unfortunately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

unfortunately.sentenceEn: Unfortunately , people create inner barriers with the help of exaggerating fears.
unfortunately.translationZh: 不幸的是，人们通过放大恐惧为自己设置了内心的障碍。
unfortunately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

unfortunately.sentenceEn: Unfortunately , life is not a bed of roses.
unfortunately.translationZh: 遗憾的是，生活并非一帆风顺。
unfortunately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

unfortunately.sentenceEn: Unfortunately , despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
unfortunately.translationZh: 不幸的是，尽管《问题的核心》这份报告历时两年半才完成，却未能触及真正的核心问题：美国顶尖高等院校中人文教育的非人文本质。
unfortunately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

universal.sentenceEn: As degrees became universal , they became devalued.
universal.translationZh: 随着大学学历变得普及，其价值也随之下降。
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

universal.sentenceEn: This universal protection sends the message: "Please don't approach me."
universal.translationZh: 这种普遍的自我保护发出了一个信号：'请不要靠近我。'
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

universal.sentenceEn: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection, perhaps the world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
universal.translationZh: 正如人类纷繁复杂的求偶仪式都可被视为性选择的表现形式一样，或许世界上的语言、音乐、社会及宗教习俗乃至历史，都受到某些普遍特征的制约。
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

universal.sentenceEn: Since the days of Aristotle, a search for universal principles has characterized the scientific enterprise.
universal.translationZh: 自亚里士多德时代以来，对普遍原理的探求一直是科学事业的显著特征。
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

universal.sentenceEn: The most famous of these efforts was initiated by Noam Chomsky, who suggested that humans are born with an innate language-acquisition capacity that dictates a universal grammar.
universal.translationZh: 这些研究中最著名的是由诺姆·乔姆斯基发起的，他认为人类天生具有一种内在的语言习得能力，这种能力决定了普遍语法的存在。
universal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

universal.sentenceEn: They have universal control of the waters.
universal.translationZh: 他们拥有控制水流的万能之力。
universal.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）

universe.sentenceEn: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe .
universe.translationZh: 在他们各自的发现问世之前，当时的许多思想家一直秉持着更为古老的思维方式，其中包括地球是宇宙中心的地心说观点。
universe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

universe.sentenceEn: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore.
universe.translationZh: 尽管教会试图压制新一代的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙运行规律的解释却以前所未有的速度涌现，人们再也无法视而不见。
universe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

universe.sentenceEn: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe , and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
universe.translationZh: 如果从更广阔的视角审视人类在宇宙中的位置，我们就会清楚地认识到，人类即使不能存活数十万年，也完全有机会存活数万年。
universe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

universe.sentenceEn: It is becoming less clear, however, that such a theory would be a simplification, given the dimensions and universes that it might entail.
universe.translationZh: 然而，考虑到这样一种理论可能涉及的维度和宇宙，它是否真的算是一种简化，这一点已变得越来越不明确。
universe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

universe.sentenceEn: Inflation says that very early on, the universe expanded in size by more than a trillion trillion trillion trillion fold in much less than a second, propelled by a sort of antigravity.
universe.translationZh: 暴胀理论认为，在宇宙形成的极早期，一种类似反引力的力量推动着宇宙在不到一秒的时间内膨胀了超过万亿亿亿亿倍。
universe.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
universe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

universe.sentenceEn: What the researchers found was at once both amazing and expected: the US National Aeronautics and Space Administration's Cosmic Background Explorer satellite—Cobe—had discovered landmark evidence that the universe did in fact begin with the primeval explosion that has become known as the Big Bang (the theory that the universe originated in an explosion from a single mass of energy).
universe.translationZh: 研究人员的发现既令人惊讶又在预料之中：美国国家航空航天局的宇宙背景探测卫星（COBE）已经发现了具有里程碑意义的证据，证实宇宙确实起源于一次原始爆炸，即我们现在所说的"大爆炸"（该理论认为宇宙源自单一能量团的爆炸）。
universe.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
universe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

ultimately.sentenceEn: The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
ultimately.translationZh: 技术研究产生的碳排放是值得的：这项研究最终将守护我们星球的未来。
ultimately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

ultimately.sentenceEn: "The most challenging moments in life are getting married, starting a family and ultimately retiring," Weiss said.
ultimately.translationZh: 韦斯说：“人生中最具挑战性的时刻是结婚、组建家庭，以及最终退休。”
ultimately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

ultimately.sentenceEn: " Ultimately ," said Jack Miner, Ohio State University's registrar, "we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time."
ultimately.translationZh: 俄亥俄州立大学注册主任杰克·迈纳表示：“最终，我们看到学生取得了更大的成功，因为他们重修了课程，并在后续课程中表现更好，或者掌握了能让他们按时毕业的内容。”
ultimately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

ultimately.sentenceEn: And ultimately , it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
ultimately.translationZh: 而最终，它很可能会在未来数年重塑我们的政治、文化以及社会特征。
ultimately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

ultimately.sentenceEn: At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
ultimately.translationZh: 无论如何，这一变化最终将受到越来越多国内外消费者的欢迎，不管当前的消费模式能持续多久。

ultimately.sentenceEn: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human. Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
ultimately.translationZh: 当然，正是这些看似多余的事物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何为人类。下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但如果无法超越下载的阶段，我们就剥夺了自己身为人类的一个关键特质。

uncertain.sentenceEn: But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best.
uncertain.translationZh: 但由于未来还有法律战要打，该区域的前景往好了说也充满不确定性。
uncertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

uncertain.sentenceEn: But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain , and far off.
uncertain.translationZh: 但在大多数情况下，这些益处显得微不足道、难以确定，且遥不可及。
uncertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

uncertain.sentenceEn: Human indignation evolved from an uncertain source.
uncertain.translationZh: 人类的愤怒情绪究竟源于何处，目前尚无定论。
uncertain.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

unconscious.sentenceEn: Companies are using artificial intelligence to remove some of the unconscious bias from hiring decisions.
unconscious.translationZh: 企业正利用人工智能来消除招聘决策中的一些无意识偏见。
unconscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

unconscious.sentenceEn: However, Allen believed that the unconscious mind generates as much action as the conscious mind, and while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone, in reality we are continually faced with a question: "Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?"
unconscious.translationZh: 然而，艾伦认为潜意识与显意识产生的行为同样多。尽管我们或许能仅凭显意识维持掌控的错觉，但实际上我们会不断面临一个问题："为什么我不能让自己做到这件事或实现那个目标？"
unconscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

unconscious.sentenceEn: We reach for them mindlessly, setting our brains on auto-pilot and relaxing into the unconscious comfort of familiar routine.
unconscious.translationZh: 我们不假思索地按习惯行事，任由大脑自动运转，沉浸在熟悉惯例带来的无意识舒适中。
unconscious.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
unconscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

unconscious.sentenceEn: A century ago, Freud formulated his revolutionary theory that dreams were the disguised shadows of our unconscious desires and fears; by the late 1970s, neurologists had switched to thinking of them as just "mental noise" – the random byproducts of the neural-repair work that goes on during sleep.
unconscious.translationZh: 一个世纪前，弗洛伊德提出了他革命性的理论：梦是我们无意识欲望和恐惧的伪装阴影；到了20世纪70年代末，神经学家们转而认为梦只是"精神噪音"——睡眠过程中神经修复工作产生的随机副产品。
unconscious.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
unconscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

unconscious.sentenceEn: And this process need not be left to the unconscious .
unconscious.translationZh: 而这一过程未必需要留待潜意识来完成。
unconscious.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
unconscious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: Animals end up stressed and unhealthy or dead.
unhealthy.translationZh: 最终，动物们变得压力重重、健康受损，甚至死亡。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: Unhealthy curiosity is possible to resist, however.
unhealthy.translationZh: 然而，不健康的好奇心是可以抵制的。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: "Many jobs are boring, degrading, unhealthy , and a waste of human potential," says John Danaher, a lecturer at the National University of Ireland in Galway.
unhealthy.translationZh: 爱尔兰国立高威大学讲师约翰·达纳赫（John Danaher）表示：“许多工作枯燥乏味、有失尊严、有害健康，并且是对人类潜能的浪费。”
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: Leading doctors today weigh in on the debate over the government's role in promoting public health by demanding that ministers impose "fat taxes" on unhealthy food and introduce cigarette-style warnings to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
unhealthy.translationZh: 今日，顶尖医生们就政府在促进公众健康方面的角色参与辩论，他们要求部长们对不健康食品征收“脂肪税”，并以香烟式警告的形式向儿童宣传不良饮食的危害。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: They argue that government action is necessary to curb Britain's addiction to unhealthy food and help halt spiraling rates of obesity, diabetes and heart disease.
unhealthy.translationZh: 他们认为，政府有必要采取行动，遏制英国人对不健康食品的沉迷，并帮助阻止肥胖症、糖尿病和心脏病发病率的急剧上升。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

unhealthy.sentenceEn: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as smoking or excessive drinking.
unhealthy.translationZh: 英国皇家儿科与儿童健康学院院长特伦斯·斯蒂芬森教授表示，食用不健康食品的危害应被视为与吸烟或过量饮酒同样严重。
unhealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

uniform.sentenceEn: Pick a standard work uniform or a few go-to options.
uniform.translationZh: 选择一套标准的工作制服或几款常用穿搭
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第3句

uniform.sentenceEn: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
uniform.translationZh: 这是否意味着，对于那些身着华丽制服、过着尊贵生活的欧洲王室成员而言，他们的末日即将来临？
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

uniform.sentenceEn: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
uniform.translationZh: 宪法原则明确规定，唯有联邦政府有权'制定统一的入籍规则'，且联邦法律优先于州法律，这两点毫无争议。
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

uniform.sentenceEn: The bodies playing major professional sports have changed dramatically over the years, and managers have been more than willing to adjust team uniforms to fit the growing numbers of bigger, longer frames.
uniform.translationZh: 多年来，从事主要职业体育运动的运动员体型发生了巨大变化，而球队经理们也非常乐意调整队服，以适应越来越多体型更大、身材更高的运动员。
uniform.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

uniform.sentenceEn: Claire C. Gordon, senior anthropologist at the Army Research Center in Natick, Mass., ensures that 90 percent of the uniforms and workstations fit recruits without alteration.
uniform.translationZh: 马萨诸塞州内蒂克陆军研究中心的资深人类学家克莱尔·C·戈登确保90%的制服和工作站无需修改就能适合新兵使用。
uniform.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

uniform.sentenceEn: She says that, unlike those for basketball, the length of military uniforms has not changed for some time.
uniform.translationZh: 她说，与篮球队服不同，军装的长度已有相当长一段时间没有改变了。
uniform.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
uniform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

unnecessary.sentenceEn: In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."
unnecessary.translationZh: 今年3月，加利福尼亚州总检察长宣布批准《加州消费者隐私法》(CCPA)下的补充法规，这些法规将“确保消费者在行使其数据隐私权时不会被混淆或误导。该法规旨在禁止‘黑暗模式’——这意味着禁止公司使用模糊语言或设置不必要的步骤，例如强迫用户点击多个屏幕或听取不应选择退出的理由。”
unnecessary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

unnecessary.sentenceEn: Further arrangements – and there may be many – between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.
unnecessary.translationZh: 英国国民医疗服务体系(NHS)与深度思维公司(DeepMind)之间可能还会有更多后续合作安排，这些安排都将受到严格审查，以确保已获得患者的所有必要许可，并且所有无关数据都已被清除。
unnecessary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

unnecessary.sentenceEn: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.
unnecessary.translationZh: 运输安全管理局不能再继续将资源投入到利用率不足的预检通道，而与此同时，大多数旅客却在不必要的长队中苦苦等待。
unnecessary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句
